tasked.dev.tools.help.motion: Animate panel opens, hovers and transitions.
tasked.dev.tools.help.snap: Snap dragged nodes to the grid while editing.
tasked.dev.tools.help.progress: Show the completion bar under each chapter's name.
tasked.dev.tools.help.palette: The palettes this pack ships; a press replaces the current look.
tasked.dev.tools.help.palette_row: Switch to this palette. It clears manual edits.
tasked.dev.tools.help.shape: The look's own shape: one knob, the corner radius.
tasked.dev.tools.help.radius: Corner radius of panels, nodes and buttons.
tasked.dev.tools.help.canvas: What is drawn over the canvas colour. Press to fold.
tasked.dev.tools.help.canvas_pattern: Flat, or a pattern drawn from arithmetic. An image names a file.
tasked.dev.tools.help.canvas_texture: The image file: type or paste an id, or press … to browse the pack.
tasked.dev.tools.help.canvas_fit: Tile repeats the image; Cover draws it once, cropped to the rectangle.
tasked.dev.tools.help.canvas_tile: How wide one repeat is drawn, in pixels. The height keeps the file's aspect.
tasked.dev.tools.help.canvas_size: Edge of a dot or speck, and the thickness of a line or hatch.
tasked.dev.tools.help.canvas_density: One cell in this many carries a speck.
tasked.dev.tools.help.canvas_direction: Which way the hatch's diagonal leans.
tasked.dev.tools.help.canvas_spacing: Distance between repeats: content units under Graph, pixels under Screen.
tasked.dev.tools.help.canvas_ink: The colour the pattern is drawn in. Its alpha is how loud the pattern is.
tasked.dev.tools.help.canvas_space: Graph moves the pattern with the content; Screen pins it to the surface.
tasked.dev.tools.help.canvas_opacity: The ink's alpha, in percent: how loud the pattern is.
tasked.dev.tools.help.canvas_copy: Write this canvas into every chapter's own theme. Each write is its own undo step.
tasked.dev.tools.help.colours: Every colour the theme defines; a press picks one to edit below.
tasked.dev.tools.help.book: The pack's book: its name and icon. Press to fold. Ctrl+Z does not cover this block.
tasked.dev.tools.help.book_title: The name shown at the top of the book, in place of the pack's own.
tasked.dev.tools.help.book_icon: The item shown beside the name. Empty draws none.
tasked.dev.tools.help.appearance: Everything under here writes this chapter's own look. Press to fold.
tasked.dev.chapter.title: Title
tasked.dev.chapter.subtitle: Subtitle
tasked.dev.chapter.missing_copy: The chapter's copy has not arrived yet
tasked.dev.chapter.missing_copy_said: The chapter's copy has not arrived yet - the server said: %s
tasked.dev.chapter.help.title: The chapter's name, in the sidebar and the book's header.
tasked.dev.chapter.help.subtitle: One line under the name, wherever the chapter introduces itself.
tasked.dev.chapter.help.icon: The item the chapter shows as its icon. Press to pick one.
tasked.dev.chapter.help.aliases: Other ids that resolve to this chapter, separated by commas - for renames and old saves.
tasked.dev.chapter.help.progression: Whether this chapter's quests may be done in any order (flexible) or only in the order they are authored (linear).
tasked.dev.chapter.help.consume_items: Whether a quest's tasks take the items they ask for, unless the quest says otherwise.
tasked.dev.chapter.help.prerequisite: How many of a quest's prerequisites must be met before it may start, unless the quest sets its own mode.
tasked.dev.chapter.help.auto_claim: Whether this chapter's quests hand their rewards over on completion, unless a quest overrides it. The unset state defers to the pack's own setting.
tasked.dev.chapter.help.line_form: The chapter's default line shape - what a line resets to when it uses the chapter default.
tasked.dev.chapter.help.line_head: The default shape drawn at the end of a line.
tasked.dev.chapter.help.line_place: Where a line's arrowhead sits: at the target, at both ends, or repeated along the line.
tasked.dev.chapter.help.line_density: How many arrowheads a repeating line draws.
tasked.dev.chapter.help.line_pattern: The default line pattern - solid, or one of the decorative ones.
tasked.dev.chapter.help.group_title: The name of the group this chapter belongs to.
tasked.dev.chapter.help.group_icon: The group's own icon. Unset, it borrows the first chapter's.
tasked.dev.chapter.help.group_collapsed: Whether the group starts folded in the sidebar.
tasked.dev.quest.help.default: Shape, size, placement and rules — the fields the reader's card does not show.
tasked.dev.help.shape: The node's outline. A click lands on exactly the pixels it draws.
tasked.dev.help.rotation: How far the node is turned, in degrees clockwise.
tasked.dev.help.size: How big the node draws on the canvas: 16 to 512 pixels.
tasked.dev.help.icon_scale: How much of the node the icon fills; the outline caps it.
tasked.dev.help.icon: The item in the middle of the node.
tasked.dev.help.show_title: Draw the quest's name under its node.
tasked.dev.help.position: Canvas position. Drag the node on the canvas, or type a number.
tasked.dev.help.repeatable: A repeatable quest can be completed again after its cooldown.
tasked.dev.help.repeat_cooldown: Ticks between completions. 2400 is two minutes.
tasked.dev.help.sequential_tasks: Tasks must be handed in in order.
tasked.dev.help.exclusive_group: Quests sharing a group lock each other out for good.
tasked.dev.help.prerequisite_mode: How many prerequisites must be satisfied: all, or any one.
tasked.dev.help.min_required: An exact count, for an "any three of five". 0 uses the rule.
tasked.dev.help.max_dependents: How many quests may complete off this one. 0 is no cap.
tasked.dev.help.add_selected: Add every node selected on the canvas as a prerequisite.
tasked.dev.help.pick_on_canvas: Arm the canvas: the next node clicked is added.
tasked.dev.help.visible_after_tasks: With Invisible on: shown once this many tasks have progress.
tasked.dev.help.hide_until_deps_done: Hidden until this quest's prerequisites are met.
tasked.dev.help.hide_until_deps_shown: Hidden until at least one prerequisite is itself shown.
tasked.dev.help.hide_dependency_lines: Do not draw the lines arriving at this quest.
tasked.dev.help.hide_text_until_done: The card shows no description until it is completed.
tasked.dev.help.hide_details_until_start: The card shows no task details until it can be started.
tasked.dev.help.id: The quest's id. Renaming it needs an alias: progress files name it.
tasked.dev.help.aliases: Other names this quest answers to, comma-separated.
